title: Exact SAT language with a fixed count of unbounded-width clauses
claims: ExactFixedWideClauseSAT checks P membership for the exact canonical language with at most k clauses wider than two, for every fixed k.
FixedWideClauseSAT checks the measured branching step for a canonical 2-CNF base and a fixed number of arbitrary-width clauses.
CNFWideClausePacking checks the measured partition on ordinary canonical CNF formulae with arbitrary clause widths.

experiments.purpose: Bind the archived Lean modules and exact statements to the recorded local reference replay. The isolated experiment reports zero Lean invocations and can be complemented by replay with the pinned reference.
